finalText:
Migrated 12 files (36 call sites) to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`
- `packages/accounts/src/{service/teamService.js, admin/apiKeyAdmin.js, repo/session.js}`
- `packages/support/src/{repo/sla.js, admin/macroAdmin.js}`
- `packages/billing/src/{service/couponService.js, repo/refund.js}`
- `packages/orders/src/{service/returnService.js, repo/shipment.js}`
- `packages/catalog/src/{repo/supplier.js, admin/variantAdmin.js}`

Two things left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13`** still calls `db.query`. Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost — so patching it there won't survive. Needs either an upstream fix or a wrapper/shim on your side; tell me which and I'll do it.
- `cache.query(...)` calls across many repos — different object, unrelated to this migration.
